intro: Every AI trading platform promises the same three things: signals, simplicity and safety. Crown Nexora adds a US$250 minimum and a demo account. This review checks what the platform actually publishes behind those promises.
The mechanics are simple: AI models scan markets, the platform suggests entries, and a partner broker executes. The minimum is US$250, the registration is free, and a practice account comes included.
The scorecard is the average of five dimensions, each scored from the platform own pages. Nothing in it is taken from testimonials, ads or the platform self-assigned rating.
